gateCatches.finding: SEC-1: clearFolderFromItems's userId-ownership clause had zero test coverage (proven by live mutation: removing it left the 76-test suite green while nulling another user's folderId). SEC-2: the 'invariant 4 — no content in audit' test only checked deep-equal shape, so a leaked folder name would have passed it (proven by live mutation of the audit call). Both were suite gaps, not shipped defects — verified correct at all enforcement points before and after the fix.

notes.overrunReason: The 400k budget was set before Security's required-fix/rework/re-verify cycle existed as a known cost (that alone added ~284k across 3 extra stage-attempts: Security Review 111,157 + Implementation rework 93,651 + Security re-verify 79,104). The remaining overage is that every stage individually ran heavier than the per-stage estimates used to set the budget, not one runaway stage — the fleet's own archetype baselines (PIPELINE_SLOS.md) will need re-checking against this run once analyze.mjs regenerates.
notes.recordedAs: UNAUTHORIZED overrun — surfaced to the operator mid-run (before Security Review, at 98% spent) with real numbers; the operator chose to proceed based on real usage-window headroom (35% of 5hr session, confirmed via /usage), not by raising the token budget to fit the spend. The 400k budget stands.
notes.leastPrivilegeNote: Orchestrator session rooted in agentic-sdlc-playbook, not in stash-seed — .claude/agents/ generated in stash-seed was not discoverable from that session root, so every stage was spawned as a general-purpose agent with its role brief inlined and full tools, not the generated least-privilege tools: frontmatter. Decided and confirmed with the operator before the run started, per CLAUDE.md's own rule against silently proceeding as if enforcement held.
notes.modelRoutingDivergence: Scope Review ran on opus (82,518 tokens), not MODEL_ROUTING.md's static default for Engineering Manager (sonnet, medium effort). This was an unprincipled choice by the Orchestrator, not a deliberate escalation — recorded per MODEL_ROUTING.md's own rule against silent divergence. No other stage diverged from its static default.

release.branchProtectionConfirmedLive: PR was mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED until the required 'Release gates' check went pass (19s) — first real end-to-end confirmation that T4's branch protection actually blocks a merge, not just that the setting exists.

notes.runArtefactsCommitNote: The code shipped for real (PR #6, merged). The run's own documentation artefacts (this file, STATE.md, 00 through 06) are left uncommitted in stash-seed for the operator's own review before they enter history — same deliberate pattern as the T1 security-hardening run, distinct from whether the feature itself shipped.
